messages:
Alex Chen: FYI - noticing a pattern across eu-west racks: multiple OOB BMCs showing NTP offsets >10s and a few nodes dropped from the GPU pool, causing pending GPU pods. impact: ~120 pending GPU pods, spikes in provisioning latency. :rotating_light:
Priya Patel: /cc @oncall - do we have correlation with the bmc firmware roll this morning?
Jamie Rodriguez: I rolled canary to 3 racks at 07:15, but paused further rollout at 08:02 after one node rebooted. logs I saw looked like clock jump then kernel watchdog...
Marta Ivanova: confirming NTP skew on BMCs. ran `ntpq -pn` on a handful of affected IPMI hosts, peers are all stratum 16 for some boxes. offsets showing 12-18s.
Ben Liu: ops-bot just reported SEL entries with `RTC adjusted by` messages + a handful of `ipmi: time sync` events.
ops-bot: [AUTO] 1766789030 - Detected BMC NTP offset >10s on 9 hosts in eu-west-1. Triggered alert and annotated the incident.
Alex Chen: quick triage plan: 1) pause any outstanding BMC firmware pushes (Jamie) 2) patch runbook to add NTP fallback (Priya) 3) force-drain only nodes with repeated kernel watchdogs, avoid mass eviction 4) consider short-term autoscale of eu-west Dedicated pool to reduce customer impact.
Jamie Rodriguez: pausing rollout now (confirmed). I can rollback the canary image on the 3 racks if we want.
Priya Patel: I'll add `pool.ntp.org` and internal NTP fallback in config and push via management plane. also opening a ticket with the firmware vendor — looks like their NTP client uses leap smearing that interacts badly with BMC RTC resets.
Marta Ivanova: running `ipmitool sel list` on an affected host, saw repeated "system time change" + BMC heartbeat gaps. posting snippet:
```
> id | sel_time                | event
> 01 2026-11-16 07:20:03  System time changed by +12 seconds
> 02 2026-11-16 07:20:05  BMC heartbeat lost
> ```
Ben Liu: Immediate mitigation: add NTP server fallback and increase kubelet `pod-eviction-timeout` from 5m to 10m on eu-west autoscaling group to avoid premature evictions while we stabilize. Ops SRE okay with that?
Alex Chen: +1 on increasing eviction window temporarily. Ben, coordinate the k8s flag change and update monitoring dashboards. Track cost delta (extra nodes) — finance will want an estimate.
Priya Patel: pushed NTP fallback to 6 affected BMCs, offsets now <1s on those. still ~3 hosts with stuck SEL entries, investigating serial logs next.
Jamie Rodriguez: rolling back canary on rack-3 to previous BMC image (confirmed) — no further reboots observed on that rack in the last 12m.
Marta Ivanova: serial backlog shows repeated NTP retries then watchdog kick. suspect race between rtc set and a fw task. filing bug with vendor + attaching serial dumps.
Ben Liu: autoscaler added 2 nodes temporarily to eu-west-gpu-pool to reduce pending pods; estimated cost for next 4h ~ $380. tagging billing.
Alex Chen: good. next steps: halt firmware rollout, finish NTP fallback rollout, rollback canary where we see reboots, extend eviction timeout for 2 hours, and prepare a communication for any Dedicated customers impacted.
oncall-bot: [AUTO] 1766792000 - Incident note: "eu-west BMC NTP drift causing GPU provisioning latency" created and linked to postmortem template.
Priya Patel: assigning myself for vendor follow-up and runbook updates. Jamie - once rollback finishes, can you run a small canary with strict NTP probes only (no other fw changes)?
Jamie Rodriguez: yes - will do an NTP-only canary on one rack after rollback validation.
Alex Chen: thanks everyone. keep thread updated with any new evictions or customer-facing errors. :thumbsup:
